title: lifecycle-gateway Configuration
description: Operator HTTP + WebSocket gateway over pkg/lifecycle.Manager (ADR-047)

allowed_origins.description: WebSocket upgrade Origin allowlist as exact-match strings. Empty list permits all origins and logs a Warn at Start; set explicitly to restrict cross-origin upgrades.

enable_websocket.description: Enable WebSocket streaming on GET {prefix}/{type}?stream=true via Manager.Watch. Default true. Set to false to disable live-update streaming and keep the gateway poll-only.

max_body_bytes.description: Maximum bytes accepted in POST .../state and POST .../transition request bodies. Default 1048576 (1 MiB). Zero or negative means use default.

path_prefix.description: URL path prefix mounted under the parent component prefix (e.g. "workflows" → /lifecycle-gateway/workflows). Default "workflows". Must be non-empty after stripping leading/trailing slashes.
